description: This PHP source file defines the AjaxCompose class, which manages sections, breadcrumbs, and related UI elements for an AJAX-based web interface within the SuiteCRM module builder. It includes methods for dynamically adding interface sections, generating JavaScript configurations, and rendering breadcrumb navigation.

classes.name: AjaxCompose
classes.description: A class responsible for managing UI components, breadcrumbs, and generating JavaScript for the AJAX interface in SuiteCRM's ModuleBuilder module.

methods.name: addSection
methods.description: Adds a new section to the AJAX interface with specified parameters such as name, title, content, and action.

methods.name: getJavascript
methods.description: Encodes the current UI sections into a JSON object for client-side rendering, ensuring default sections are added if missing.

methods.name: addCrumb
methods.description: Adds a breadcrumb item with a name and associated action.

methods.name: getBreadCrumb
methods.description: Generates HTML for the breadcrumb navigation based on the current crumbs and their actions.

methods.name: echoErrorStatus
methods.description: Outputs a JSON-encoded error message with an optional label name.
